title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for persistent joint pain and stiffness.

HPI
The patient is a 58-year-old male presenting today for a follow-up evaluation of chronic knee and hip discomfort. He reports that the stiffness is most severe in the mornings and improves slightly with movement throughout the day. He notes that he has been attempting to stay active by walking, but some days he experiences sharp pain in the right knee. He denies any recent falls or new injuries. He states his goal is to increase his mobility and reduce the use of over-the-counter anti-inflammatory medications.

Medication List
- Sertraline 50mg daily
- Naproxen 500mg as needed

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Physical examination of the right knee reveals mild swelling and decreased range of motion compared to the left side. There are no signs of acute erythema or warmth. Muscle strength in the lower extremities is 5/5.

Assessment
1. Chronic joint pain.

Plan
The patient will continue his current exercise regimen and we will monitor his progress over the next month. He was advised to continue using his current medication list as prescribed. Follow-up in four weeks.
explanations: An antidepressant on the list does not establish major depression; coders do not infer diagnoses from medications.

distractors.why: Only the provider can document a diagnosis.
